Should I just head back upstairs and take a cab instead?
traps: 使用 'How long time will it take?'，这是中式英语，应用 'How long will it take?'。
使用 'When can it be good?' 来表达什么时候修好，非常不地道，应用 'When will the service be back to normal?'。
使用 'Do you have other car?' 来问其他交通工具，car 泛指汽车，应问 'Is there any alternative transportation?'。
talk_ask_subway_delay.ai: Alex 扮演地铁乘务员。他会告诉你正在排查，但他也不知道准确时间，需要你追问具体的替代路线。
talk_ask_subway_delay.task: 弄清楚大概还要等多久，并问清是否有免费接驳巴士可以换乘。

tgt: Huge congrats on the new place! I’m honored you invited me, but I’ve had a crazy week and really need to catch up on some sleep this weekend.
I’m going to have to pass this time, but I hope you have an incredible party!
Let me stop by to see your new place when things are a bit quieter.
traps: 说成'I am tired so I won't go'太直接，显得对庆祝活动不感兴趣；应说'I’ve had a busy week and need to recharge'.
直接说'No'不加解释；应说'I’d love to, but I have to pass this time'.
说成'You guys have fun'听起来像是在推开对方；应说'Hope you all have a fantastic time'.
soc_decline_party_invitation.ai: 同事，性格活跃，认为派对是放松的好机会，不理解你为何想待在家里。
soc_decline_party_invitation.task: 委婉表达自己周末需要休息，但对他买新房表示真诚祝贺。

tgt: I'm happy with my current shopping experience, no upgrades today.
Let's just stick to the standard checkout, please.
I've heard enough, thank you, but I'm definitely not interested.
traps: 说'I don't want to upgrade'，语气略显生硬，用'I'm happy with my current shopping experience'更委婉。
说'No membership'，语境不全，应说'Let's just stick to the standard checkout'。
说'Stop talking about this'，这在服务场景非常失礼，应说'I'm definitely not interested'。
life_no_retail_upward.ai: Alex是收银员，他的KPI要求他每天完成一定数量的会员转化，他认为你经常来，办会员绝对划算。
life_no_retail_upward.task: 拒绝会员升级，让收银员专心完成你的当前结账。

tgt: I have a train to catch in 20 minutes, and my passport is inside that locker.
Is there any way to override the system manually? This is an emergency situation.
I’m worried I’ll miss my train. Can we please find a solution right now?
traps: 错误说“You have to open it now”语气太冲。应说“Could you please prioritize this as I have a train to catch?”。
错误说“My passport is lost in your machine”。准确描述为“stuck in the locker”。
错误说“You are responsible for my train ticket”。应侧重于“Can we resolve this quickly?”以解决问题为导向。
life_tour_locker_stuck.ai: Alex是车站工作人员，他表示处理这种问题需要申请审批，可能需要半小时。
life_tour_locker_stuck.task: 请求他特事特办，因为你有紧急行程

tgt: I missed my connecting flight to Beijing because of this two-hour delay.
Could you please endorse my ticket for the next available departure?
I need an official delay certificate to submit to my airline.
traps: 说成 'My train was delayed so I missed my flight.' 时态和因果连接不够紧凑，地道说法应用 because of this delay 强调直接影响。
请求改签时说 'Can you change another train for me?' 介词搭配错误，change for 表达不准，应用 endorse my ticket 或 book me onto。
索要证明时说 'Give me a paper for delay.' 表达极其口语化且中式，应用 official delay certificate。
life_emo_train_delay.ai: Alex 扮演车站值班员。他会先向你道歉并解释是突发故障，当你要求赔偿或改签时，他会告诉你标准流程并解释由于不可抗力无法全额退票，需要你据理力争。
life_emo_train_delay.task: 向值班员说明错过航班的严重后果，争取免费改签到最近的一班车并获取延误证明

tgt: Excuse me, some paint just dripped onto the carpet here.
I just had this carpet cleaned, could you please wipe it up?
Do you have a damp cloth or some cleaner to remove this stain?
traps: Avoid 'You made the carpet dirty.' Use 'There's a stain on the carpet.'
Avoid 'Please clean it for me right now.' Soften with 'Could you please help me clean this up?'
Avoid 'I need to use your liquid.' Use 'Do you have any cleaning supplies?'
talk_home_paint_stain.ai: 油漆工，表示歉意并愿意清理，但需要你提供洗涤用品。
talk_home_paint_stain.task: 要求对方清理污渍，并确认清理方式。

tgt: I seem to have lost my season pass somewhere around the summit restaurant during lunch.
Here is my ID and my original purchase confirmation email. Can we deactivate the lost card and print a replacement?
I’m fine with paying the 50-yuan replacement fee as long as my remaining access days get transferred.
traps: 常说“My card is lost, give me a new one.”，“give me”显得像是在索要，没有体现补办和交费的流程，地道说法应用“Can we deactivate the lost card and print a replacement?”。
常说“I lost my ticket on the mountain table.”，“mountain table”中式直译，餐馆的桌子应说“table at the mountain restaurant”。
常说“I want to find my card back.”，“find back”是典型中国式英语，找回东西应用“retrieve my card”或“look for my lost card”。
hob_ski_lost_pass.ai: Alex 扮演雪卡服务中心（Ticket Window）的工作人员。他正在电脑前处理退票业务，听到你的情况后需要核对你的身份信息和购买凭证。
hob_ski_lost_pass.task: 出示身份证件和购票订单号，说明季卡不慎遗失，并申请注销旧卡、补办一张新卡（需支付 50 元工本费）。

tgt: I sincerely apologize, officer. I picked up this rental today and didn't notice the light was out.
I understand the safety risk. Could you direct me to the nearest 24-hour shop where I can get this replaced?
Is it possible to get a temporary warning so I can reach a repair shop safely?
traps: 说 'I don't know it's broken' 显得推卸责任。应说 'I apologize for the oversight; I wasn't aware of the issue'。
说 'It's not my fault, it's the rental' 语气像是在甩锅。应说 'The rental company provided it this way, but I realize it's my responsibility now'。
说 'Can you ignore this?' 太冒犯。应说 'Is there any flexibility for me to fix it immediately?'。
hob_car_headlight_fix.ai: 交警。他认为你作为驾驶员有责任检查车况，不接受“不知道”作为借口。
hob_car_headlight_fix.task: 表达歉意并询问附近哪里有24小时配件店或车行能处理

tgt: Hi, I'm staying in room 412. My dress shirt got really wrinkled during the flight. Do you have an iron and ironing board that I could borrow for my room?
I promise to return it to the front desk within an hour.
Thank you so much for your help.
traps: 说 'My cloth is all lines' 是糟糕的中式英语。衣服有折痕的标准说法是 'My shirt got really wrinkled'。
说 'Can I borrow one iron?' 冠词使用错误。正确的可数名词单数前要加 'an iron'。
说 'I will give it back to you' 语气像是在交还公文。酒店语境下用 'return it to the front desk' 更加专业和地道。
soc_borrow_iron_hotel.ai: Alex 扮演酒店前台值班员杰西卡。她听到你的需求后告诉你酒店有熨斗可以免费借用，但需要你留下房号并承诺用完送到前台。
soc_borrow_iron_hotel.task: 向酒店前台借用熨斗和烫衣板在房间使用

tgt: Pardon me, but this is a well-done T-bone, and I actually ordered a medium-rare filet mignon.
Given that I have a show to catch at 8:30, could you please have the kitchen rush my order?
If it's going to take more than fifteen minutes, I'll have to cancel this dish and just pay for the drinks.
traps: 常说 "You give me the wrong food"，听起来像在指责对方故意给错，地道说法是 "There seems to be a mix-up with my order" 或 "I think this is the wrong dish"。
常说 "Make it fastly"，"fastly" 不是英语单词，副词应该是 "quickly" 或用动词 "rush"，地道说法是 "Could you rush this order?"。
常说 "My time is very limited"，偏生硬，日常表达赶时间说 "I'm in a bit of a rush" 或 "I'm pressed for time" 更自然。
life_eat_wrong_order_remake.ai: Alex 扮演餐厅领班。他看到上错菜后会立刻道歉，并评估重做需要的时间，同时安抚你的情绪。
life_eat_wrong_order_remake.task: 指出菜品错误，并催促餐厅加急重做以赶上下一个行程

tgt: Excuse me, I've been waiting for my steak for over 45 minutes now. Could you check if there's an issue with my order?
I see that the people who arrived after me have already finished their meals. Is there a delay?
I'm getting quite hungry. Could you please look into this or let me know how much longer it will take?
traps: “My food is slow”是错误表达，应该说“There's a delay with my order”或“The service is a bit slow”。
“You forgot my food”带有指责意味，地道说法是“I'm worried my order might have been missed”。
“Why is theirs faster than mine?”听起来像在吵架，建议说“I noticed others have been served, so I was wondering about mine”。
life_emo_restaurant_wait.ai: 服务员，很忙，刚才甚至没注意到你这桌的订单出了小插曲，被叫住时显得有些手忙脚乱。
life_emo_restaurant_wait.task: 冷静地询问进度，并明确表达你的不耐烦，但保持礼貌。

tgt: I think this machine and I are having a profound philosophical disagreement.
It's judging my life choices, not the apples.
Should we just adopt this apple and pay rent for it instead?
traps: 容易说成 'The machine doesn't work well again.'，纯粹是抱怨，没有网感和幽默感。
容易把‘机器报错’说成 'machine is wrong'，口语里用 'having a philosophical disagreement' 来拟人化开玩笑才地道。
容易用 'I am sorry for waiting.' 语气过分卑微，在闲聊场景下自嘲更受欢迎。
talk_joke_self_checkout.ai: Alex 扮演排在后一位的顾客。他见机器又卡住了，想开个玩笑缓解你的尴尬。
talk_joke_self_checkout.task: 用自嘲的语气回应结账机的频繁报错，和后面的顾客开个玩笑。

tgt: Is this vaccine necessary for my dog's lifestyle?
Are there any common side effects I should look out for?
How often does he need to get this shot?
traps: 说成 'Is it dangerous?'，疫苗通常问 'Are there side effects?'，用 'dangerous' 显得太恐慌。
说成 'When does he need the needle?'，针剂用 'shot' 或 'vaccination'，不用 'needle'。
说成 'Is it good for him?'，应问 'Is it necessary for his lifestyle?'，体现出你关心狗的日常环境。
talk_pet_vet_vaccine.ai: 兽医，态度耐心。他解释说因为你常带狗去森林公园，所以接种很有必要，副作用通常只有轻微的嗜睡。
talk_pet_vet_vaccine.task: 询问疫苗必要性并了解潜在副作用

tgt: What hydration percentage do you usually use for this sourdough?
How long do you let the dough bulk ferment at room temperature?
Could you share a few tips on getting such an open crumb structure?
traps: 询问时说 What water rate do you use? 错误搭配，烘焙中的水分比例标准术语是 hydration percentage 而不是 water rate。
问发酵时间说 How much time does the dough ferment? 表达不够地道，通常用 bulk ferment 来指代面团的基础发酵阶段。
评价气孔时说 Your bread has big holes. 显得词汇贫乏，在烘焙圈更地道的赞美是 open crumb structure。
hob_write_bakery_sourdough.ai: Alex 扮演面包师。他很乐意交流，但会笑着告诉你这是店里的招牌比例，不过可以把大致的静置时间和折叠次数告诉你。
hob_write_bakery_sourdough.task: 向面包师打听酸种面包的具体水合比和发酵时间，写进烘焙日记

tgt: Hi, I saw that my ride was cancelled. Is everything okay?
Is it too dangerous to drive there because of the heavy rain?
Do you think I should wait for another driver instead?
traps: 说成 'Why you cancel me?'，语法错误，应使用 'May I ask why the ride was cancelled?'。
说成 'I am waiting for a long time'，带有抱怨情绪，应改为 'I've been waiting for a while, is there any problem with the route?'。
说成 'You must come here'，语气强硬，应使用 'Is there any chance you could still pick me up?'。
life_wx_uber_cancelled.ai: Alex 扮演司机。他解释说雨太大且路面积水严重，他无法安全到达你的接送点。
life_wx_uber_cancelled.task: 确认取消原因并询问是否能再次接单

tgt: I've been hooked on some single-player RPGs on PS5 lately.
That avatar looks sick! Where did you get it custom-made?
Are you playing on a Quest 3 or a PCVR headset?
traps: 说自己沉迷于某个游戏说成 'I am very addicted to'，虽然没错但不够口语化，常用 'I've been hooked on'。
夸别人的模型很酷说成 'Your model is very cool'，年轻人在虚拟社区更常用 'Avatar looks sick'。
问设备的牌子说成 'What machine do you use'，硬件玩家之间会直接问 'Quest 3 or PCVR headset'。
hob_video_vr_chat_meet.ai: Alex 扮演这个热情的玩家，他夸你的 avatar（虚拟形象）很酷，并问你平时除了VR还玩什么主机游戏。
hob_video_vr_chat_meet.task: 聊聊你最近在玩 PS5 上的单机大作，并询问对方的 VR 设备型号

tgt: Do you accept contactless payment or Apple Pay?
Can I tap my phone here to pay?
Is contactless card accepted for this amount?
traps: 容易说成 'Can I use phone pay?'。'Phone pay' 不是国外标准说法，正确的统称是 'contactless payment'。
容易说成 'Do you have Apple Pay machine?'。应该问是否接受该支付方式，即 'Do you accept...'。
容易说成 'Can I scan code?'。国外很多咖啡店不流行扫码付，感应支付的标准动作是 'tap'（tap my phone/card）。
life_eat_confirm_payment_method.ai: Alex 扮演收银员。他指了指刷卡机，微笑着告诉你手机支付完全可以使用。
life_eat_confirm_payment_method.task: 向收银员确认是否可以使用手机感应支付

tgt: My checked bag from flight BA278 hasn't come out yet.
Could you help me file a delayed baggage report?
What is the best way to track the delivery status?
traps: 错用单词：说成 'My luggage is lost.' 显得过于绝对且吓人。地道说法是用 'delayed' 或 'haven't arrived yet' 比较准确。
动词搭配错误：说成 'do a report'。地道英文里填写或出具表格通常用 'file a report' 或 'fill out a form'。
句型生硬：说成 'Where can I know when it comes?' 带有明显的中文直译腔。地道表达是 'How can I check the update?' 或 'When can I expect it?'
talk_trip_airport_baggage.ai: Alex 扮演机场地勤，态度友善且效率高，会配合你查询行李状态并协助你填写报失单。
talk_trip_airport_baggage.task: 完成行李报失登记，并询问大概什么时候能送到酒店。

tgt: I specifically ordered the pan-seared fish, item number 7, not this raw beef.
I have a severe allergy to raw meat, so I really can't touch this dish.
Could you please take this back and replace it with the correct order?
traps: 常说 'You gave me the wrong food'，带有指责意味，用 'I believe there's been a mistake' 更委婉。
常说 'I cannot eat this'，不够正式，用 'I'm allergic to...' 或 'I have a dietary restriction' 更地道。
常说 'Change it for me'，应使用 'replace'，如 'Could you replace this with the fish dish?'
talk_story_wrong_order.ai: Alex 是侍应生，他坚持说是你点错了，但在确认菜单后愿意为你更换。
talk_story_wrong_order.task: 说明自己点了 7 号且对生食过敏，礼貌但坚定地要求更换餐点。

tgt: Is there an existing internet connection in the apartment?
Do I need to sign up for my own Wi-Fi service?
Could you recommend a reliable internet provider in this area?
traps: 说成 'Do you have internet?'。含义不明确，应用 'Is there an internet connection'。
说成 'Do I need to buy Wi-Fi?'。Wi-Fi 是无线信号，宽带服务应说 'internet service'。
说成 'Who is the internet shop?'。运营商叫 'internet provider' 或 'ISP'。
life_rent_ask_wifi_setup.ai: Alex 是房东，他告诉你网络需要自己办理，并推荐了一家当地运营商。

tgt: Hi, I'm calling from terminal 1. Is the hotel shuttle on its way?
How much longer will the airport pickup van take?
Where does the hotel shuttle usually pick up passengers?
traps: 问车什么时候来，说成 'When the bus will come?'。疑问句语序错误，正确的是 'When will the bus arrive?'。
说成 'The car is not coming.' 语气过于绝对，表达“还在路上/还没到”用 'is still on its way' 更合适。
问上车地点说 'Where is the hotel car stop?'。酒店接机车位通常叫 'pickup zone' 或 'loading zone'。
life_way_hotel_shuttle.ai: Alex 扮演酒店前台接线员。他在电话那头帮你查询班车司机的实时位置。
life_way_hotel_shuttle.task: 打电话给酒店前台催问接机班车什么时候到

tgt: I'm feeling a bit nervous about my first stage performance next month.
Do you have any tips on how to stay calm when singing in front of people?
What should I do if I forget the lyrics while on stage?
traps: 说成 'I am very scared'，太严重，用 'feeling a bit nervous' 刚好。
说成 'How to not be nervous?'，用 'How to stay calm' 正向表达更好。
说成 'If I forget words'，歌词用 'lyrics'，不用 'words'。
hob_sing_performance_nerves.ai: Alex是老师，他理解你的心情，分享了一些缓解紧张的实用小贴士。
hob_sing_performance_nerves.task: 分享担忧并询问缓解方案

tgt: What kind of flavor notes can I expect from this Ethiopian roast?
Do you recommend a specific brewing method to highlight its fruity profile?
Is it better to keep the water temperature on the lower side to avoid over-extraction?
traps: 说成 'What is the taste?' 太笼统。地道说法是 'What are the flavor notes?' 或 'What is the flavor profile?'
说成 'How to brew this?' 语法不完整。应该说 'Could you suggest a brewing method for this?'
说成 'I want to buy some bean.' 豆子一般用复数。应说 'I'd like to buy some beans.'
hob_coffee_specialty_bean_inquiry.ai: 咖啡师，很热情，强调这种豆子有独特的蓝莓余韵，但提醒你如果冲煮温度超过92度会产生过多酸涩感。
hob_coffee_specialty_bean_inquiry.task: 了解豆子的风味轮廓并获取最佳冲煮建议

tgt: Chicago to St. Louis is a double route, so both of us can build here.
I actually drew my ticket for this specific connection three turns ago.
You can still use the parallel track right next to mine.
traps: 容易说成『This line has two tracks, so you can build too.』，词汇不够精准，地道说法是『Chicago to St. Louis is a double route, so both of us can build here.』
容易说成『I got this ticket three turns before.』，时间副词用错，地道说法是『I actually drew my ticket for this specific connection three turns ago.』
容易说成『You can use another track nearby.』，方位不够具体，地道说法是『You can still use the parallel track right next to mine.』
hob_chess_ticket_route.ai: 克洛伊，你的游戏对手。她原本也打算走这条双轨路线，觉得你打乱了她的布局，想确认你是不是拿错路线卡了。
hob_chess_ticket_route.task: 向克洛伊说明这条双路线允许双向占用，且你已经完成了你的城市连接任务

tgt: I totally see your point—the CGI characters just didn't have the same emotional charm as the 1998 hand-drawn original.
That being said, the underwater battle sequence on the big screen was visually stunning enough to justify the nineteen-dollar ticket.
Hollywood really needs to stop remaking every single classic animation and just come up with some fresh scripts.
traps: 说‘我完全理解你的看法’用 'I completely understand your idea'。地道说法是 'I totally see your point.'。
说‘特效场景’说成 'special effect scene'。地道说法是 'visually stunning sequence' 或 'CGI scenes'。
说‘好莱坞应该停止翻拍’用 'Hollywood should stop to remake'，动词不定式用法错误。地道说法是 'Hollywood should stop remaking...'。
talk_movie_animation_vs_live.ai: Alex 扮演热情的本地退休老人。他年轻时看过原版动画，对新出的真人版特效和魔改剧情感到痛心疾首，语气中充满幽默的吐槽。
talk_movie_animation_vs_live.task: 回应 Alex 的吐槽，承认真人版确实不如原版有灵气，但指出某些特效场景还是值回票价的。

tgt: You really saved me; I have no idea how long I would have been stuck here.
Please, take this for lunch on me, it’s the least I can do.
You were so kind to take the time to help a stranger.
traps: 不要说'I pay you for help'，这会冒犯人，应说'Please let me treat you to lunch'。
不要说'Help me is hard'，应说'It was very kind of you to help'。
不要说'Here is your money'，太直接，应说'Please, have this on me'。
soc_thanks_car_jump.ai: 路人，觉得帮人搭电很常见，不想拿钱。
soc_thanks_car_jump.task: 感激对方的帮助，并说服对方收下这笔钱作为午餐费。

tgt: Hey, my rear tire got a puncture about two kilometers down the road. Could you help me replace the inner tube?
Do you think the tread on this tire is worn out enough to warrant a replacement?
I use 700 by 25C tires with Presta valves. Do you have these in stock?
traps: 把法嘴说成 French valve。虽然外国人能听懂，但行业标准说法是 Presta valve。
说成 My tire is broken。爆胎通常用 puncture 或 flat tire。
说成 Do you have this kind of tire in your shop。地道说法是 Do you have these in stock。
hob_bike_puncture_repair.ai: Alex，修理铺的年轻店员。他手头有活但很乐意帮忙，他会建议你顺便换个更耐扎的防刺内胎。
hob_bike_puncture_repair.task: 请 Alex 帮忙换内胎，并顺便检查外胎有没有被划破。

tgt: I think there might be a mistake with the weight on this price tag.
It says 1.2 kilograms, but it should be 0.8 kilograms.
Could you please re-weigh this for me?
traps: 说成 'The weight is not correct.' 有点生硬，用 'There might be a mistake' 更委婉。
说成 'Help me to weigh it again.' 指挥语气，应用 'Could you please re-weigh this for me?'
说成 'This is 6 dollars, but it is not.' 表达不清，应用 'The price label shows... but it should be...'
life_food_wrong_weight.ai: Alex 是称重台工作人员，他会带着你一起去重新称量，并帮你修正标签价格。
life_food_wrong_weight.task: 告知对方秤重有误，请求重新称重。

tgt: The dinosaur exhibition is on the second floor, right past the lobby.
The next English guided tour starts at 2 PM.
Would you like to grab a map of the museum before you go?
traps: 说成 'Dinosaur room is upstairs.'。展厅不用 'room' 而用 'exhibition' 或 'hall'。
说成 'English guide is at 2 PM.'。'Guide' 指人，导览服务应用 'guided tour'。
说成 'Do you want a map?'。稍微生硬，用 'Would you like to grab a map...' 更热情礼貌。
hob_volunteer_museum_guide.ai: Alex 是一位带孩子的游客，走过来向你询问下午的恐龙展厅在哪一层，以及还有没有英文导游。
hob_volunteer_museum_guide.task: 告知游客恐龙展厅的位置和下一场导览时间

tgt: I bought this sweater earlier, but it’s a bit too tight. Do you have it in a large?
Could I exchange this for a size large, please?
Would you mind checking if you have this in a larger size?
traps: 说成 'I want to change this.'，容易被误认为想要换钱或换别的款式，地道说法应加 exchange for。
说成 'It is too small for me.'，虽然没错，但用 'It’s a bit tight' 更符合描述衣物尺码的语感。
说成 'Do you have bigger size?'，漏掉了冠词 'a'，应说 'Do you have a bigger size?'。
life_shop_clothing_size.ai: 店员，礼貌且高效，确认库存后愿意帮你更换。
life_shop_clothing_size.task: 成功换到一件大一码的衣服

tgt: Which specific shampoo should I use for his sensitive skin?
Should I use lukewarm water instead of cold water?
I'll keep an eye on him while drying his fur.
traps: 说成 'Which shampoo is good?' 太过宽泛，地道说法应用 'Which specific shampoo should I use for his sensitive skin?'
说成 'Water need warm?' 缺少主谓，地道说法应用 'Should I use lukewarm water instead of cold water?'
说成 'I look at him.' 表达不准，地道说法应用 'I'll keep an eye on him while drying his fur.'
hob_volunteer_dog_grooming.ai: Alex 是兽医助理，他会建议你换用柜子里的燕麦低敏洗发水，并告诉你如何安抚狗狗的情绪。
hob_volunteer_dog_grooming.task: 了解狗狗的特殊护理要求，并更换合适的洗涤用品

tgt: These ribs smell amazing! What kind of dry rub are you using?
I've tried making these at home, but I can never get the texture this tender. What's your secret?
Do you find that letting the meat sit overnight makes a big difference in the flavor?
traps: Don't say 'What is in your rub?', say 'What kind of ingredients are in your dry rub?' to sound more curious and less interrogating.
Avoid 'How do you do this?', say 'What's your technique for getting the meat so tender?' to be more specific.
Don't say 'You cook very well', say 'You've really mastered the art of BBQ' to sound more natural.
talk_food_barbecue_party.ai: 邻居，对自己的秘方很自豪。他愿意分享食材，但对关键的烟熏时间守口如瓶，你需要引导他多聊聊。
talk_food_barbecue_party.task: 通过夸赞邻居的厨艺，让他透露一些关于腌制时间的窍门

tgt: Can you ship this ceramic vase to my address?
Will you pack it securely with bubble wrap?
How much is the shipping fee within the state?
traps: 问能不能寄说 'Can you send this to my home?'。send 太泛泛，快递物品地道动词是 ship，如 'Can you ship this fragile item for me?'。
要求用气泡膜说 'Use plastic bubbles to wrap it.' 气泡膜的地道英文是 bubble wrap，不说 plastic bubbles。
问邮费多少说 'How much is the post fee?'。邮费的标准说法是 shipping fee 或 postage，不说 post fee。
hob_collect_antique_store_shipping.ai: Alex 扮演古董店老板，微笑着告诉你店里可以提供加厚气泡垫包装和邮寄服务。
hob_collect_antique_store_shipping.task: 确认包装安全并安排快递寄送

tgt: That sounds like a nightmare. You couldn't even enjoy the movie.
Some people have absolutely zero awareness of their surroundings.
I would have been so annoyed if I were you.
traps: 说成 'He kicked your chair.'，没把语气带出来。应该说 'That’s so rude, kicking the seat like that'。
说成 'He is not awareness.'，语法错误。应为 'He lacks awareness' 或 'He has no spatial awareness'。
说成 'You can change your seat.'，多余的建议。对方已经看完电影了，应聚焦于安慰 'That must have been so distracting'。
soc_gossip_movie_theater.ai: Alex是电影爱好者，他觉得这种干扰极大地毁了他的观影体验。
soc_gossip_movie_theater.task: 安慰Alex，表示自己也非常讨厌观影期间的各种骚扰行为。

tgt: I accidentally formatted my SD card and I'm really desperate to recover the photos from today.
Do you happen to have any reliable recovery software you'd recommend for this?
Would you mind if I borrowed your card reader to run a quick scan on my own laptop?
traps: 说成 'I lost my data'，信息不够具体。应说明是 'I accidentally formatted my SD card'。
说成 'I am very nervous'，表达情绪不够地道。可以用 'I'm really desperate to recover...'。
说成 'Can you lend me your reader?'，语气偏强。用 'Would you mind if I borrowed...' 更合适。
hob_photo_sd_card_recovery.ai: 房东，表示可以尝试恢复，但强调不能保证100%成功，且现在他的电脑正在进行备份，可能要半小时后才能腾出空档。
hob_photo_sd_card_recovery.task: 表达对数据的重视，询问是否有专业的恢复软件推荐，并确认是否可以现在借用他的读卡器先自行尝试。

tgt: Keep the voucher, please. I really don't need any facial treatments.
I'm not interested in skin care products or services. Thank you anyway.
I have to run now, so please don't take up my time.
traps: 使用 'Give back your voucher to you'，表达累赘且语法错误，地道表达应用 'Keep the voucher, please' 或 'Here, you can keep this'。
使用 'My skin is very good'，略显自夸且对付推销显得不够自然，地道表达应用 'I'm happy with my current skin routine' 或 'I don't need any facial treatments'。

life_no_spa_voucher.ai: Alex 扮演美容院员工。他会指出你脸上有点干燥，并顺势邀请你预约本周的具体体验时间。
life_no_spa_voucher.task: 把券退还给对方，明确表示不需要并结束对话。

tgt: I understand your policy on force majeure, but I'm leaving the country tomorrow and won't be able to use a voucher.
Since the service was completely cancelled, would it be possible to make an exception for a refund under these special circumstances?

traps: 说成 'You are cheating me'，指责对方作弊，应说 'I find the refund policy very inflexible.'
说成 'I want my money back now'，命令式语气，应说 'Could you please consider a refund, as a voucher is not viable for me?'
说成 'This is not the rule'，应说 'Could you please clarify if there's any flexibility in the refund policy?'
life_wx_tour_cancellation.ai: Alex是旅行社客服，他严格执行公司规定，只同意提供一年有效的代金券，不接受现金退款。
life_wx_tour_cancellation.task: 打破对方的“公司规定”，要求全额或部分退款。

tgt: I am so sorry, I think I ordered the wrong side dish.
Is it possible to change this? It was my mistake.
I apologize for the extra work.
traps: 避免说 'You brought the wrong food'，这会怪罪到对方身上，应说 'I think I made a mistake with my order'。
避免说 'Change it for me'，应加礼貌用语 'Could I please change this?'。
避免说 'I want to return this'，这听起来像退货，应说 'Could I exchange this dish?'。
soc_sorry_wrong_order.ai: Alex 是服务员，他过来确认用餐情况。
soc_sorry_wrong_order.task: 向服务员道歉，并询问是否能更换。

tgt: Looks like we're in for a bit of a wait with this delay.
Are you heading out to Chicago for work or just visiting?
Well, hopefully, they'll start boarding soon. Fingers crossed!
traps: 说成 'The plane is delay again.'。delay 是动词或名词，应该用形容词 delayed，说成 'The flight is delayed again.' 才对。
回答对方时说 'I go to Chicago for meeting.'。时态和冠词错了，去开会应用进行时或将来时，说成 'I'm heading there for a business trip.' 更地道。
结束聊天时说 'We talk later.'。这是中式直译，道地表达应该用 'Nice chatting with you, hope your flight goes smoothly.'
soc_small_flight_delay_chat.ai: Alex 扮演邻座旅客。他一开始有点沮丧，但你搭话后会很乐意跟你抱怨天气，并顺便问你也是去开会还是旅游。
soc_small_flight_delay_chat.task: 顺着延误的话题开启对话，聊聊各自的行程，并自然地结束抱怨

tgt: I have to move out three months early due to an unexpected relocation and would like to discuss the lease breakage fee.
Would you be open to waiving part of the penalty if I help find a qualified new tenant?
Is there any flexibility in the lease terms given my circumstances?
traps: 不要说 'I want to break the contract'，这听起来像是在摧毁合同，应用 'terminate the lease' 或 'end the lease early'。
不要说 'Can you give me a discount of the fine'，应用 'waive' 或 'reduce' the penalty。
不要说 'I have a big reason'，太模糊，应说 'Due to personal circumstances' 或 'Due to a job relocation'。
life_rent_lease_break.ai: 房东 Alex。他担心这三个月房子空置没收入，但他可以考虑减免，如果你能帮他找到下家的话。
life_rent_lease_break.task: 说明情况并尝试减免部分违约金，或者商讨寻找转租人的方案。

tgt: Sorry, would you mind giving me a little bit more personal space? It’s a habit of mine.
I apologize, I prefer to keep a bit more distance while waiting in line.
Could we step back a little? I’d appreciate the extra space.
traps: 说 'Don't touch me'，语气过激，应说 'Could you give me a bit more space?'。
说 'You are standing too close'，像是指控，应说 'I’m sorry, I’m just a bit sensitive about personal space'。
说 'Why you follow me?'，造成误解，应说 'I’d be more comfortable with a little more room'。
talk_cul_personal_space.ai: Alex 是你后方的乘客，他觉得这是正常的排队间距，对你退后一步保持距离的行为感到奇怪。
talk_cul_personal_space.task: 温和地提醒对方保持一定的社交距离。

tgt: The shuttle is 20 minutes behind schedule, and I'm going to miss my lesson.
Since this is due to the shuttle delay, would the hotel consider covering a taxi for me?
I really can't afford to wait another 20 minutes, is there any alternative transport?
traps: 说成 'The bus is late' 很口语，说 'behind schedule' 更符合商务语境。
说成 'Pay for my taxi' 有点无礼，说 'covering a taxi' 显得有礼貌且专业。
说成 'I have no choice' 表达太消极，说 'I really can't afford to wait' 表达了你的迫切。
hob_ski_shuttle_delay_4444.ai: 酒店前台。他联系了司机，被告知由于路面结冰车速极慢，预计还得等20分钟，但他坚持让你再等等。
hob_ski_shuttle_delay_4444.task: 说明自己因为课程时间紧迫，询问前台能否安排出租车并由酒店报销费用。

tgt: For percentage-of-completion revenue, we need objective evidence to support the stage of completion — not just an internally signed report.
Could we get the independent engineer's or supervisor's progress certification to corroborate the amount recognized?
Without independent progress evidence, we may need to revisit the amount recognized this period.
traps: "The progress report only signed by you is not objective." — only signed by you 是中式语序夹在名词后，别扭。地道："A progress report signed only internally isn't objective enough."
"Your signature cannot represent the real progress." — represent the real progress 直译腔，real 太口语。地道："Your sign-off alone doesn't corroborate the actual stage of completion."
"We cannot accept this progress report." — cannot accept 太直接、像否决，语气过强。地道："We're not able to rely on this report alone."
aud_evid_construction_poc.ai: Alex 扮演客户项目总监。他认为工程进度他最清楚，内部报告有他签字已能说明问题，第三方监理报告要额外付费且滞后。他先介绍项目进展顺利，再解释为什么没有监理确认。
aud_evid_construction_poc.task: 向Alex说明完工百分比需要客观证据支撑，要求取得第三方监理或工程师的进度确认文件。

tgt: If the operating licence covering roughly 70% of revenue is revoked, that would call into question the entity's ability to continue operating.
The fact that the case is ongoing doesn't remove the need to assess it — we need your legal view on the probability and timing of an adverse outcome.
Can you obtain external legal opinion on the likelihood of revocation, so we can reflect it in the going concern assessment?
traps: 「The license may be canceled」中 cancel 用于许可证不准确，吊销执照用 revoke / withdraw a licence；cancel 多用于合同、订阅。
「It is under investigation, so no need to consider」直译「还在调查所以不用考虑」，no need to consider 偏口语且绝对；专业说法是 the matter is still under investigation, but it still needs to be assessed。
「Please ask lawyer for opinion」直译且笼统，律师意见应说 legal opinion，且通常指 external legal opinion；地道说法是 obtain external legal opinion on the likelihood of revocation。
aud_gc_license_revocation.ai: Alex 扮演客户法务总监。他先说明案件尚在调查、公司已在整改，认为最终吊照可能性不大，主张暂时不必纳入持续经营评估。他愿意配合，但希望低调处理。
aud_gc_license_revocation.task: 评估吊销许可证的可能性及对持续经营的影响，要求管理层在评估中纳入该事项并提供法务意见。

tgt: The three significant points need your input before Monday — can we lock in 30 minutes tomorrow?
I'll clear the minor ones today, but I'd rather not leave the big three to the last minute.
If we only clear them on Monday, there's no buffer to act on your follow-ups.
traps: “清问题”说 clear the questions —— questions 偏一般疑问；复核点叫 review points / review notes，“清Q”地道说 clear the review points。
“留到周一”说 leave to Monday —— 缺介词；应说 leave them until Monday / push them to Monday，不能省 to/until。
“回应你的意见”说 react your comments —— react 是不及物动词，后须接 to（react to your comments）；且审计里更地道说 address / action your comments。
aud_plan_review_clearing.ai: Alex 扮演你的项目合伙人。他不是在躲，而是这几天被两个客户的审计委员会会议缠住；他认为大多数Q是小问题，建议你先清掉简单的，把三个重大的留到下周一一早集中过。
aud_plan_review_clearing.task: 让合伙人在本周内腾出一段专门时间清掉三个重大Q，而不是拖到周一，确保还有补救时间。

tgt: Is the guarantee joint and several, and must the landlord pursue the subsidiary before coming to us?
Has the landlord been notified that the subsidiary has ceased operations?
Where do the early-termination negotiations stand, and what's the break cost?
traps: 把“子公司关停”说成 'the subsidiary is closed'——closed 指关门；财务语境应说 'has ceased operations' 或 'has been wound down / is dormant'。
把“租约自然到期”说成 'let the lease expire naturally'——naturally 多余且不专业；应说 'let the lease run to term' 或 'let it expire'。
把“房东不会追究”说成 'the landlord won't pursue'——pursue 可用，但配担保更精准的是 'unlikely to enforce the guarantee'。
dd_cont_lease_guarantee_closed.ai: Alex扮演行政总监（负责行政后勤）。他认为子公司已无业务、房东不会追究，且正在协商提前退租。他务实、好沟通，但没把这份担保当回事。
dd_cont_lease_guarantee_closed.task: 确认担保性质（连带保证或一般保证）、房东是否已知子公司停业、提前退租谈判进展，评估剩余敞口。

tgt: This service account hasn't had its password rotated in over two years.

If it's still needed, can we get the password rotated and an owner assigned?
traps: 说 The password is not changed for two years——表状态用 not changed 不如被动完成 hasn't been changed，且 IT 审计固定搭配是 rotate the password，应说 The password hasn't been rotated in over two years。
“owner 一栏是空的”直译成 The owner is empty——empty 描述表格字段不地道；应说 the owner field is blank 或 no owner is documented。
说 Please change the password and fill the owner——fill 搭配错（fill 用于 fill in a form），且命令式；“登记/指派 owner”应说 assign an owner / document an owner。
aud_it_service_account.ai: Alex 扮演客户IT应用系统经理，负责ERP与合并系统接口。他配合、就事论事：承认这是历史遗留、密码确实很久没动，但强调接口一直在跑、没出过事，想先搞清楚审计要的是改密码、还是补登owner，还是都要。
aud_it_service_account.task: 向IT经理说明服务账号既要有明确的owner、密码也要定期轮换，并和他确认这个账号是否仍在用、若在用则安排改密和补登owner。

traps: 说"the subcontractor did a bad job"，过于主观且不专业，地道表达应该用客观描述问题，比如"the report has incomplete supporting documentation and data discrepancies"。
直接要求暂扣尾款但不说明依据，显得随意，地道表达应该先说明整改未完成的情况再提扣款权限。
用"you should let me do this"，语气过于命令式，地道表达应该用委婉请求的"could we be authorized to"。
wk_boss_align_subcontractor_quality.ai: 你的质控合伙人Lisa，她会先询问你是否已经和分包商沟通过整改要求，再讨论如何把控后续交付质量，不会直接指责分包商的问题。
wk_boss_align_subcontractor_quality.task: 向Lisa对齐后续分包质控的验收标准，并申请授权可以暂扣5%的分包款作为整改保证金

tgt: Can you provide the payment receipts for all the lease security deposits?
Could you share the latest credit status reports of the landlords associated with the high-value deposits?
I need to assess the recoverability of the security deposits that are related to the litigated landlords.
traps: Saying "your deposit is risky" is too negative; a more neutral way is "Let's evaluate the recoverability of the security deposits based on the landlords' current business situations".
Using "get back" instead of "recover" when talking about financial assets is too casual; the correct professional term is "recover the security deposits".
Forgetting to specify the amount of the at-risk deposits is a common mistake; instead of saying "some deposits", you should clearly state "the 3 deposits totaling 4.2 million RMB".
dd_lease_check_deposit_risk.ai: Alex是标的公司的资金经理，他会说明目前尚未收到房东的逾期通知，愿意提供保证金的支付凭证和房东的经营状况说明。

I’ve noted that 17 new employees in the operations team didn’t have social insurance during their first 3 months of employment. Can you walk me through this process?
Could you share the employment contracts that outline the probation period benefits?
traps: Using "they didn't pay social insurance" is grammatically imprecise, use "their social insurance contributions weren’t made during the probation period" instead.
Saying "you don’t follow the rules" is confrontational, use observational language like "I’ve noticed a deviation from standard statutory requirements" instead.
Translating "转正后" directly as "after becoming regular" is awkward, use "after completing the probation period and becoming a full-time employee" for natural professional English.
dd_hr_trial_period_social.ai: Alex是人力招聘主管，他的立场是配合尽调，希望解释公司内部的试用期管理惯例，配合提供相关的员工入职协议。
dd_hr_trial_period_social.task: 确认试用期内未缴纳社保是否符合当地劳动法规

I’ve coordinated with our team to prepare a detailed sorting checklist to help your staff complete the work efficiently, so it won’t take too much extra time.

traps: Saying "we have a lot of files to sort" is too vague and doesn’t give specific numbers, you should state the exact number of documents and timeline to make the request more credible.
Using "you have to help us" uses the wrong tone, it sounds like you’re demanding rather than collaborating, the correct phrasing is "could we work out a plan to support each other".

wk_res_finance_report_staff.ai: 行政部主管Noah，他的诉求是优先完成本部门的年度档案归档工作，担心借调人手会延误档案整理的截止日期。

wk_exit_tax_lead_leave.task: 和陈琳确认项目的核心交付物和对接方，协调内部资源完成项目交接，保障申请按时提交。

tgt: I read *The Happy Sleeper* when my sister was a new mom, it totally changed how we approached bedtime routines for her toddler.

tgt: Even if the credit risk is minimal, the prolonged collection cycle significantly impacts the working capital efficiency.

traps: 1. 错误地将'国企'直译为 'national company'，这不符合商务英语习惯。地道的说法应该是 'state-owned enterprise' 或简写为 'SOE'。
2. 在表达'无法回款/坏账核销'时，错误地使用直译腔 'cannot return money'。地道财务英语应使用 'uncollectible' 或 'bad debt write-off'。
3. 在表达'计提折让'时，错误地搭配为 'calculate a haircut'。在财务估值语境中，通常搭配动词 'apply'，说成 'apply a haircut' 或 'provide for a haircut'。
dd_ar_soe_budget.ai: Alex 是买方的投资总监。他希望评估真实的交易对价，态度客观，但对国企回款的“行业惯例”有些犹豫，想听听你的专业分析再做决策。
dd_ar_soe_budget.task: 顶住对方“国企不会赖账”的托词，用英文向 Alex 阐述即使无实质坏账风险，超期账款也会占用资金成本，且存在合规隐患，建议计提准备。

tgt: I’ve been trying to finish a full book without checking my phone every 10 minutes, it’s been so hard lately.
I love the hand-drawn bookmarks here—did you make them yourself?
The last time I sat down to read a novel was back in January, I really miss that focused feeling.
traps: 说"I no have time to read"，错误原因：中式英语的否定结构错误，地道说法是"I don’t have time to read"。
说"I very busy work"，错误原因：语序和介词错误，地道说法是"I’m very busy with work"。
说"You like draw pictures"，错误原因：动词形式错误，地道说法是"Do you like drawing pictures?"
soc_deep_bookstore.ai: 小周是辞职来成都开书店的前程序员，只是随口抱怨最近来店里的年轻人都只拍网红照不看书，没有真的想和你聊天的意思。
soc_deep_bookstore.task: 从聊读书的习惯聊到你最近因为工作压力太大，很久没静下心读完整一本书的焦虑。

tgt: Hi Alex, quick question: when did I say the package would be delivered? I thought it was this Wednesday but I'm not sure.
Sorry, I forgot to clarify the delivery date for the package I asked you to pick up. Can you remind me what I told you?
Just to double-check, is the package arriving this Wednesday or next Wednesday that you need to collect for me?
traps: "You didn't remember" 语气带有指责，会让邻居感到尴尬，应该用"I'm not 100% sure"来表达自己的不确定。
"When is the package?" 过于模糊，应该明确说明是代收的时间细节。
"I tell you Wednesday" 语法错误且中式直译，地道表达应该用"I mentioned Wednesday"来描述自己说过的内容。
life_clarify_neighbor_package.ai: Alex是你的隔壁邻居，平时见面很友好，此刻正在家门口拆快递，愿意帮你确认代收的时间细节。
life_clarify_neighbor_package.task: 向邻居确认快递的正确送达时间，确保他会在对应的日期代收你的快递。

tgt: I’ve really enjoyed working on the cross-border compliance projects with this team over the past year, and I wanted to talk through my reasons for leaving before I finalize my departure.
We’ve got a number of ongoing client inquiries, and I want to make sure there’s no gap in support while we finalize the transition.
I can arrange a meeting with you to discuss any adjustments to my role or compensation that would make me reconsider staying with the team.
traps: 使用"I don’t like my job"这种过于情绪化且不专业的表达，在正式沟通中应使用"I’ve received an opportunity that aligns more closely with my long-term career goals"来保持专业度。
直译"日常咨询工作"为"daily consult work"是中式英语，地道的表达应为"day-to-day client advisory support"。
使用"If you don’t keep me, I’ll leave"这种威胁式表达，应使用"I would value the chance to discuss potential career growth opportunities within the firm"来体现积极的沟通态度。
wk_exit_team_junior_consultant.ai: Alex扮演李萌，她是团队的初级咨询顾问，离职原因是收到了一家四大会计师事务所的合规专员offer，现在正式通知你离职计划，同时表示对团队有很深的感情。
wk_exit_team_junior_consultant.task: 了解李萌的离职真实诉求，尝试挽留并确认项目交接的时间节点

tgt: I have the parking receipt right here showing I paid fifteen dollars.
My toddler's car seat is in the back. I legally cannot drive home without it.
Can we please verify the parking zone on the receipt before you process the fee?
traps: 用 "You stole my car" 控诉对方偷车。拖车属于合法执法或民事留置行为，指控 "stole" 会直接导致对方拒绝沟通甚至报警，地道应说 "My car was wrongfully towed"。
把没有安全座椅没法开车说成 "My child must need the seat"。"must need" 语气生硬且语法不自然，地道应用 "I cannot legally transport my child without the car seat"。
使用 "Open the door of my car" 命令对方开门。这显得很不客气且不专业，地道应说 "Could you please let me retrieve my child's seat from the vehicle?"。
talk_car_impound_dispute.ai: Alex 扮演态度蛮横、按章办事的拖车场看守员。他要求你先交350美元罚金才能看车，不听任何关于停错车位的解释。
talk_car_impound_dispute.task: 据理力争，要求先拿到车里的婴儿安全座椅，并对这笔拖车费提出异议。

tgt: It actually references declassified internal documents from the 1980s.
The host breaks down how clinical trials were strategically funded.
It's grounded in investigative journalism rather than conspiracy theories.
traps: 用 'It talks about companies hide the truth' 语法过于松散。地道表达应使用名词性从句或动名词：'It exposes how corporations conceal research findings'.
想表达'这个播客不是乱说的'直译为 'This podcast is not talking nonsense'，语气过重且不地道。建议用 'It is thoroughly fact-checked and well-researched'.
用 'I agree with what the podcast says' 缺乏说服力。地道口语常用 'The evidence presented in the episode is quite compelling'.
talk_book_food_industry.ai: 赶着回家、对社会流行话题持怀疑态度的芝加哥居民。他认为媒体总是为了流量夸大健康风险，要求你说明这个播客到底提出了什么真实的数据或内部证据。
talk_book_food_industry.task: 在寒风中排队的几分钟内，向他解释该播客引用的具体调查研究（如食品大厂的资助内幕），改变他对该播客的偏见。

tgt: There's a certain beauty in things that have been lived in.
I feel like new things lack the soul that comes with a bit of wear and tear.
It reminds me that our own scars and flaws tell a story worth sharing.
traps: 误说 "The clothes are old and cheap"（衣服又旧又便宜），贬低了物品。地道说法是 "I appreciate the character of vintage pieces"（我欣赏古着物品的个性）。
使用 "I want to have a story"，语意含糊。地道说法是 "I'm drawn to items with a sense of history"（我被有历史感的物品吸引）。
直译 "I am not perfect"，太突兀。地道表达为 "I've learned to embrace my own imperfections"（我学会了拥抱自己的不完美）。
soc_deep_sf_thrift.ai: Alex 是个充满艺术气息的店员。他想知道你这种“寻求故事”的心态，是否反映了你对自己人生现阶段某种“不确定性”的迷恋。
soc_deep_sf_thrift.task: 谈论你对“旧物”的迷恋，并延伸到你对自己人生阅历积累的看法，表达一种不畏磨损的人生态度。

tgt: I know you want a dream wedding, but spending $35,000 will delay our home savings goal by two years.
What if we do an intimate local ceremony and save the beach idea for a special honeymoon?
Let's see if we can find a middle ground that feels special without breaking the bank.
traps: 直译“破产”或“花大钱”为 'without losing all money'（地道表达“不花暴多钱/不破费”应使用 'without breaking the bank'）。
将“小规模婚礼”直译为 'small wedding'（虽然可以，但用 'an intimate ceremony' 显得更体面优雅）。
错用介词写成 'delay our savings goal for two years'（表达延后多长时间，此处用 'by two years' 更准确）。
soc_partner_wedding_scale.ai: 扮演你的伴侣 Alex。认为婚礼一生只有一次，希望请齐亲朋好友隆重庆祝，但意识到两人的预算差距较大，愿意协商折中方案。
soc_partner_wedding_scale.task: 表达对海岛婚礼浪漫氛围的认可，分析 $35,000 开支对两人买房首付计划的影响，提出兼顾仪式感与预算的折中方案。

tgt: Not much, just planning to walk around the city.
How about you? Any plans?
Just a quiet weekend at home. Card, please.
traps: 直译 'I have no plan' 显得冷漠生硬，像是不想和对方说话。地道表达可以用 'Not much' 或 'Nothing special' 来轻松带过。
回答太长，如 'I will go to British Museum first and then eat fish and chips...' 变成了做工作汇报。日常闲聊只需一两句概括即可。
忘记回问对方。在西方闲聊中，别人问你之后，回一句 'How about you?' 是一种最基本的礼貌社交礼仪。
talk_cul_tesco_small_talk.ai: 收银员 Alex，非常友好，这只是他工作中的标准礼貌闲聊（small talk），并没有探听你个人隐私的意思。
talk_cul_tesco_small_talk.task: 顺着他的话作简短、友好的回答，并礼貌地完成付款结账。

tgt: I am so sorry I'm late, the Tube was a total mess today.
Please forgive me for being late, I feel terrible about it.
Is there anything I can help you with to make up for my late arrival?
traps: 说成 'Sorry for late.'，缺了冠词，应说 'Sorry for being late'。
说成 'The subway stopped.'，伦敦人管地铁叫 'the Tube'，且 'stopped' 表达不准确，用 'delayed' 或 'had a signal failure' 更专业。
说成 'My time was wrong.'，这听起来像是在推卸责任，直接说 'I got stuck in traffic/transit' 更好。
soc_guest_late_arrival.ai: Tom，派对主人，正在厨房忙着准备餐前小食。他不会生气，但需要你帮他把刚买的6瓶啤酒放进冰箱。
soc_guest_late_arrival.task: 诚恳道歉并主动提出帮忙

tgt: I've got a dull ache in my lower back that gets worse by the afternoon.
Does acupuncture hurt when the needle goes in?
How many sessions do you think I'll need for this chronic tension?
traps: 说成 "My lower back is always pain in afternoon"。语法错误，应用 "a dull ache in my lower back that gets worse by the afternoon"。
说成 "Will the needle pain?"。"needle" 不能作为动词主语，应用 "Does acupuncture hurt when the needle goes in?"。
说成 "How many times I need to come?"。语序错误，地道表达应为 "How many sessions do you think I'll need?"。
talk_health_acupuncture_clinic.ai: Alex 扮演针灸师，他仔细聆听你的描述，用手按压了几个穴位确认痛点，并向你解释针灸可以帮助放松经络。
talk_health_acupuncture_clinic.task: 准确向针灸师描述腰部酸痛的特点和持续时间。

tgt: I'm struggling with tennis elbow, so I need something with better shock absorption.
Is this racket head-heavy or head-light?
Do you have a demo program so I can try it out on court first?
traps: 不要说 My hand hurts，说 Tennis elbow 医生和专业人士才懂。
不要说 The racket's weight is at the front，专业说法是 It's a head-heavy racket。
不要说 Can I use it for free for a while?，应问 Do you offer demo rackets?。
talk_sport_tennis_racket_advice.ai: Alex 是店里的资深导购，他推荐你尝试一款碳纤维材质的新款，但价格比普通的高出 100 澳元。
talk_sport_tennis_racket_advice.task: 咨询这款球拍的性能。你需要询问它的平衡点（头重还是头轻）、对减震的效果，以及是否可以提供试打（demo）。

tgt: I'm terribly sorry to bother you, but my tracking info shows the parcel was signed for at this address.
It's a large box with a Dyson logo on it; did the courier perhaps leave it by your door?
Would you mind if I double-check the hallway just in case it was moved?
traps: 一上来就说 "You took my parcel"，这带有攻击性。应礼貌开头 "I'm looking for a misdelivered package"。
说 "My parcel is very expensive"，容易激起对方反感。应说 "It's a high-value item I've been waiting for"。
请求查看时说 "I want to see your camera"。地道表达是 "Would you be comfortable checking your doorbell camera footage?"。
life_post_london_neighbor.ai: 邻居Henderson先生。他不喜欢被打扰，对快递员乱放包裹在自己门口感到恼火，甚至可能已经把包裹推到了楼梯间或拒收了。
life_post_london_neighbor.task: 礼貌但坚定地询问包裹去向，如果他确实没收到，请求他允许你查看他门口的监控（如果有）或者确认快递员的签名。

tgt: I sincerely apologize, I got caught up in the moment and shouted right as he tossed the ball.
I didn't mean to interfere with his service, it won't happen again, I promise.
Thank you for the warning, I will stay completely quiet during the rallies.
traps: 用 'I am too happy so I yell' 表达激动喊叫。表达极其幼态，地道表达是用 'I was caught up in the excitement' 或 'It was an accidental outburst'。
用 'He is not starting play yet' 为自己辩解。抛球瞬间属于比赛进行中，地道说法是 'He was already in his service motion'。
用 'Don't drive me out' 直译‘别赶我出去’。生硬且低姿态，地道表达应是 'I assure you I won't cause any more disruption, please let me stay'。
talk_sport_table_tennis_cheering_mistake.ai: Alex 是现场的安保队长，态度严肃生硬，强调球员发球前必须保持绝对安静，认为你是故意干扰对方选手。
talk_sport_table_tennis_cheering_mistake.task: 诚恳解释自己是过于激动非故意在发球瞬间发声，承诺遵守规矩，避免被驱逐。

tgt: I'm researching antique brass aesthetics for my blog. What are the key indicators of a genuine 19th-century patina?
Would you mind demonstrating the difference between these two pieces for my readers?
Is there a reliable way to distinguish authentic aging from artificial chemical treatment?
traps: 不要说 'How to see if it's real'，太口语化。应说 'What are the key indicators of authenticity'。
不要说 'How do you clean the brass'，这里重点是鉴定。应说 'What are the signs of genuine patina'。
不要说 'Is this fake'，太直接容易得罪人。应说 'How can we distinguish between authentic aging and artificial treatment'。
hob_write_antique_market.ai: Alex 是摊主，他会考验你的眼力，他会拿出两件看起来一样的饰品，让你猜哪个是原件。
hob_write_antique_market.task: 请教他鉴定黄铜物件氧化包浆的要点，并请他演示如何通过金属气味或质地判断年份。

tgt: Could you break down the €142 — how much is duty and how much is VAT?
I've got the original invoice showing $439; where should I send it?
If I pay today, can you confirm it won't be returned to sender?
traps: 把关税和增值税混成一个 "the tax"，对方没法回答你。这是两笔钱，要分开说 "customs duty" 和 "VAT"；个人包裹别用 "tariff"，那是讲国家间贸易政策的词。
"Please tell me the reason why my package is detained by you." 又被动又过分正式，而且 "detained" 通常用于扣留人。地道说法是 "Can you tell me why it's being held?"
"I want to pay now, quickly." 句尾甩一个 quickly 像在催人。说 "I'd like to pay today so it doesn't get sent back." 把急迫理由讲出来，比催促自然。
life_post_vat.ai: Alex 扮演快递公司清关专员。他按流程办事，愿意逐项解释这笔钱怎么算、要哪些材料，语气公事公办；但金额和期限是系统出的，他改不了。
life_post_vat.task: 问清 142 欧里关税和增值税各多少、按什么价值算的，今天就把款交掉并把发票发过去，确认包裹不会被退运。

tgt: The pattern shows up in nine months out of nine, so I can't treat it as a one-off.
I'm not making a comment on intent — the draft just describes what the ledger does.
If you'd prefer, I can drop the word 'reversed' and show month-end against month-average balances instead.
traps: 说 "The money comes back at the beginning of next month."——come back 太口语、指向不清。资金退回说 refunded / reversed shortly after month-end / paid back in early July。
说 "I did not mean to blame you."——blame 一出口就把对话抬到指控层面。撇清指控说 "This isn't a comment on intent" 或 "I'm not suggesting anything improper."
说 "the receivable is fake low"——fake 是「伪造的」。要说 understated at month-end 或 artificially low at each month-end。
dd_rep_wc_month_end.ai: Alex 扮演目标公司财务总监。他说那是正常的客户对账节奏、不是刻意做账，只是不希望写得像操纵。他会举具体客户的例子，也会问你数据是从哪一张表拉的。
dd_rep_wc_month_end.task: 保住这个事实描述，同时把「这不是在指控动机」用英文说明白，并给出替代写法。

tgt: I'm really sorry to drop this on you — my parents' train gets in at quarter past ten on Saturday.
I could be there by two and stay as late as you need, if the van's still around.
If Saturday's the only day that works, tell me now and I'll find you someone to cover my slot.
traps: 别说 “I want to cancel our appointment.” —— appointment 用于看医生、剪头发这类预约，朋友之间帮忙不用它，而且 cancel 听起来是取消不去了。要说 “I need to push our Saturday back” 或 “Can we move Saturday?”
别说 “I will try my best to come.” 就收尾 —— 英语里这句等于没承诺，对方没法排人。要给确定的数：“I'll be there by two” 才是他能拿去安排的话。
别用 “Please give me a favor.” —— 固定搭配是 do someone a favour。你这场其实反过来：欠人情要说 “I owe you one.”
life_invite_move_sunday.ai: Alex 演这位朋友，通情达理但确实被你打乱了。他先正常商量能不能挪；然后会摆出硬约束——货车只租了周六、另外两个人也只有周六有空、新房子周一就要交接，会问你能不能让别人去接父母、或者只来两小时也行。
life_invite_move_sunday.task: 尽早通知并道歉，在他的硬约束下谈出一个具体可执行的方案（比如周六两点后到、或周日补上收尾的活），别含糊地说「我尽量」。

tgt: I'll be honest — I don't know enough about that side of it to have an opinion.
I can see why people feel strongly about it. I'm mostly here for the football, though.
What I'd really like to understand is why the atmosphere gets that intense.
traps: 说 "I have no comment." —— 这是发言人在记者会上的用语，语域太硬，在客厅里会被听成「我不想跟你说话」。日常说 "I'd rather not get into that" 或 "That's a bit above my head, honestly."
把「我不想聊政治」直译成 "I don't want to talk about politics." —— 语气过于生硬，等于当面下逐客令。软化成 "I'm probably the wrong person to ask about that."
说 "It's just a game, don't be so serious." —— 直接否定对方在意的事，居高临下。改成先认可再收回自己那一半："For me it's just a great game to watch — but I get that it's more than that here."
talk_sport_derby_host.ai: Alex 扮演房东，苏格兰人，流浪者球迷。他先是正常讲球队历史、讲球场里的气氛和歌声，聊着聊着自然带出自己那一套看法，语气热情，希望你点头附和。他不是在盘问你，只是习惯了同桌的人跟他站一边；你要是含糊，他会追问一句「come on, you must have a view」。
talk_sport_derby_host.task: 让他觉得你听懂了也尊重他，但不站队、不表态，把话题拉回球本身，并且能舒服地跟他看完下半场。

tgt: An increase in working capital is a use of cash and therefore reduces free cash flow.
A decrease in working capital is a source of cash, which increases free cash flow.
Negative working capital isn't automatically bad; in a grocery retailer like Woolworths, customers pay upfront while suppliers are paid 30–60 days later, so it can support faster growth.
traps: 'Working capital increase means cash outflow.' 中文：缺少冠词和介词，英语中名词短语需要说 'an increase in working capital'，且动词应搭配 'represents' 而非直译 'means'。地道说法：'An increase in working capital represents a cash outflow.'

'Negative working capital is definitely bad for the company.' 中文：用 'definitely' 过于绝对，面试中应体现条件性，且 'bad for the company' 语域模糊，应使用 'not necessarily a sign of distress' 等表达。地道说法：'Negative working capital is not necessarily a sign of distress; it depends on the business model.'

'The company has negative working capital, so it's good for cash flow.' 中文：缺少冠词（应为 'a negative working capital'），且 'so it's good for cash flow' 口语化，面试中应使用 'this can be favorable for cash flow' 更正式。地道说法：'Having a negative working capital can be favorable for cash flow, as the company uses supplier credit to fund operations.'
itv_nwc_change_and_negative_wc.ai: AI 演投行 VP，熟悉 FCF 勾稽和零售业模式，会顺着你的回答追问“为什么增加是现金流出”或“负营运资本有什么风险”，语气专业但直接。
itv_nwc_change_and_negative_wc.task: 这一场他要用英文把 ΔNWC 与 FCF 的关系讲清楚，并说明负营运资本在零售业为何通常是良性，避免绝对化表述。

tgt: I had my 90-minute Thai massage appointment today, but the therapist was 20 minutes late and the service was not up to standard.
I made a reservation for TH-789 at 3pm, could I get a redo of the massage or get a discount?
Sorry to say this, but the massage I received just now wasn't as good as I expected.
traps: 说"This massage is terrible!"，语气太情绪化，当地店铺希望用更委婉的方式反馈问题
直接要求全额退款，没有说明具体问题，店长不知道哪里出了问题，应该先描述服务的情况
忘记提到预约编号和预约时间，地道表达需要补充这些具体信息
talk_complain_bangkok_massage_shop.ai: Alex扮演按摩店的店长，会主动过来道歉并询问你的体验，愿意调整服务。
talk_complain_bangkok_massage_shop.task: 礼貌反馈服务问题，要求重新安排一次合格的按摩或者减免部分费用

tgt: Oh sorry, I didn’t mean to bump your cue there.
Take all the time you need to reset your shot.
That was totally my mistake, go ahead and fix it up.
traps: 说"You move your cue"会显得指责对方，应该主动承认自己碰到了对方的球杆。
把"pool cue"说成"pool stick"虽然也可以，但在台球语境下cue是更地道的说法。
没道歉就直接击球，会显得不礼貌，应该先道歉再继续比赛。
talk_sport_pub_pool.ai: Alex是你的对手，他是经常来这家酒吧打球的本地爱好者，他只是停顿了一下，看着被移动的白球。
talk_sport_pub_pool.task: 礼貌道歉，让对手重新调整位置，继续比赛。

tgt: We are traveling together, but we booked our tickets separately.
Is there any way we could get seats next to each other?
Here are both of our booking references.
traps: 表达不体面：说 "We want to sit together" 听起来像小孩子提要求。在得体社交场合，用 "get seats next to each other" 或 "be seated together" 更大方、客气。
用词生硬："Change our seats to be together." 用 "change" 显得生硬，地勤可能会直接拒绝说没有空位。用 "Is it possible to..." 或 "Would you mind checking if..." 更好。
概念不清：把订单号说成 "ticket number"。虽然也可以，但更准确的说法是 "booking reference" 或 "confirmation code"（即机票确认信上的6位字母数字组合）。
life_air_sit_together.ai: 冰岛航空的值机地勤，表示目前航班比较满，但他会尽力在系统里帮你们调换空余的相邻座位。
life_air_sit_together.task: 向地勤说明你们是一起出行的，提供两张机票的信息，并请求将座位安排在一起。

tgt: My 14:17 train to Liverpool is delayed by over 2 hours, and I have a dental appointment at 5pm I can't make now.
Could you please give me a written proof of the delay so I can reschedule my appointment?
Is there any compensation available for this long delay?
traps: 说"the train is late"太平淡，应该用具体的"is delayed by over two hours"说明影响
用"I need a paper"太中式，地道说法是"written proof"或者"official delay certificate"
直接要求补偿"give me money"，应该用更委婉的"Is there any compensation available?"
soc_bad_train_delay_manchester.ai: Alex是站台乘务员，他正在处理晚点列车的乘客问询，听到你过来后停下脚步准备听你说明。
soc_bad_train_delay_manchester.task: 向乘务员说明延误情况并索要延误证明

tgt: Sorry about that! I totally confused you with Zoe who helped me with my mountain pose last week.
Your white yoga outfit looks just like hers, that’s why I made the mistake.
Could you tell me when the next restorative yoga class starts?
traps: 在瑜伽馆这种安静的场景下大喊名字，会影响其他学员，应该用更轻的语气；
用"I think you are Zoe"，不确定的情况下应该用"I mixed you up with"而不是直接肯定；
用过于正式的"I apologize for my erroneous identification"，在瑜伽馆这种轻松场景下过于生硬
soc_name_yoga_instructor_mixup.ai: Alex是瑜伽馆的新兼职教练，她不是Zoe，此刻正拿着瑜伽垫愣在原地。
soc_name_yoga_instructor_mixup.task: 道歉并解释误会，询问下一节课程的时间

tgt: This steakhouse has some amazing local wagyu, would you like to start with a glass of Australian sauvignon blanc?
It’s a nice break from the back-to-back regulatory meetings, how’s your trip to Sydney going so far?
Just to align, we’re planning to submit the final compliance draft by next Friday, does that work for your team?
traps: 用“红酒”直译“red wine”，澳洲本地职场常用“sauvignon blanc”或者具体的本地酒款来体现专业语境，避免过于笼统
用“我有一个时间”直译“I have a time”，不符合商务语境，地道说法应该用“planning to submit the final draft by next Friday”
打断对方的用餐，直接进入主题，没有先享受午餐的氛围
wk_small_sydney_lunch.ai: Alex扮演澳洲本地律所合规合伙人Emma，她刚结束和澳洲证监会的线上汇报，想先放松一下，再和你确认合规尽调的后续时间节点。
wk_small_sydney_lunch.task: 自然开启午餐场景的寒暄，回应对方的工作状态，确认时间节点

tgt: I’m so sorry, I didn’t mean to knock your plate at all.
Could you let me know how much I should compensate for the damaged plate?
I can pay for a replacement or cover the cost of the dish if you’d prefer.
traps: Saying "I didn’t do it on purpose" sounds defensive in English, native speakers usually lead with acknowledging the mistake first instead of justifying yourself.
Translating "刮花" directly to "scratched" is okay but "chipped" is more accurate here since the edge was damaged, using the right word makes your apology more sincere.
Using "give me money" is too direct and rude, native speakers use "compensate" or "cover the cost" to sound polite in this situation.
life_acc_cafe_table_scrape.ai: Alex是邻桌的顾客，他刚点的这份烟熏三文鱼班尼迪克蛋配套的餐盘，是他特意选的限定款餐具，现在有点不高兴，想要跟你沟通赔偿的事。
life_acc_cafe_table_scrape.task: 诚恳道歉并和对方商量合理的赔偿方案，平息对方的不满情绪。

tgt: The device overheated and shut down within just an hour of normal use.
An overheating dashcam is a major safety hazard, not a normal feature.
I'm not comfortable with a replacement; I'd like a full refund.
traps: 弱弱地反驳 "My car AC is very cold!"。这会让对话陷入无意义的争论，应职业化地声明："My car's air conditioning was fully functioning."。
把故障说成 "This machine is dangerous, I want money."。不合商务日常语境，应用 "This product is defective and poses a safety risk, so I'd like to return it."。
说 "I don't want to change, I want refund."。表达有些中式且破碎，地道说法是 "I'm not interested in an exchange, I'd prefer a refund."。
life_shop_faulty_dashcam.ai: 汽车用品店店员。解释说“电子产品在暴晒下过热保护是正常的，可能只是你车里空调开得不够凉，不能算质量问题退货，只能换同型号”。
life_shop_faulty_dashcam.task: 反驳店员关于“空调不够冷”的荒谬借口，指出这是严重的设备故障（malfunction），坚持要求全额退款而拒绝换货。

tgt: I'm terribly sorry, Officer. The crowd was so energetic that I lost track of those few extra minutes.
I was just finishing up an encore and I’m packing my gear away right now.
Could you please let me off with a warning this time? I’ve always been strictly on time before.
traps: 说 "It's only 8 minutes"。这在法律意识强的国家是狡辩。地道说法是 "I apologize for the slight delay in wrapping up"。
说 "People love my music"。警察不在乎音乐好坏，只在乎规章。应说 "I didn't mean to violate the permit duration"。
使用 "Don't give me a ticket"。这太直接。地道表达是 "I'd be very grateful if you could consider a verbal warning given my clean record"。
talk_music_madrid_busking.ai: 巡警Garcia，他平时对噪音管理很严，正准备掏出罚单本记录你的违规行为。
talk_music_madrid_busking.task: 向警察道歉并解释是因为观众要求返场（Encore），承诺立即收摊，争取不被记入违规名单。

tgt: I've checked around the living room, but I couldn't find the pocket Wi-Fi.
Is there a specific place where the pocket Wi-Fi is usually kept?
No worries at all, please let me know if you can help me locate it.
traps: 直译 "Where is my Wi-Fi?"。虽然语法正确，但语气过硬，听起来像在质问。地道、客气的说法是 "I couldn't find the pocket Wi-Fi device in the room."。
说 "You lied to me about the Wi-Fi"。在对方可能只是漏放的情况下，用 "lied" 会直接激化矛盾。地道表达应用客观描述，如 "It seems to be missing."。
使用 "I want the Wi-Fi now" 表达迫切需求，显得非常无礼。地道询问应是 "Could you let me know how we can sort this out?"。
soc_conflict_airbnb_wifi.ai: Alex 扮演房东。他十分抱歉，表示可能是上一位房客放错了地方，他非常愿意配合你寻找，或者今天晚些时候送一个新的过来。
soc_conflict_airbnb_wifi.task: 告诉房东房间里找不到便携 Wi-Fi，并询问具体位置或解决方案。

tgt: I was looking at our bank statement, and the delivery fees are adding up.
We're spending more on takeout than on our actual groceries.
How about we prep some meals on Sunday to save time during the week?
traps: 说 'We eat too much outside'。地道说法是 'We're ordering in too often' 或 'We're eating out too much'。
将 'Adding up' 误用为 'Totaling up'。'Adding up' 指细碎的开支累积成一笔巨款，这里更地道。
错误使用 'I suggest we do meal prep'。口语常用 'Shall we try meal prepping?'。
soc_partner_food_delivery.ai: Alex。立场是：下班后真的不想洗碗和备菜。他觉得点外卖节省的时间可以用来休息，增加幸福感。
soc_partner_food_delivery.task: 通过具体的账单数字说服 Alex，并提议周末进行 Meal Prep（批量备餐）来解决周中的劳累问题。

tgt: You did absolute magic on my coat, the stain is completely gone!
I brought a box of macarons to show my heartfelt thanks for the rush job.
You really saved my evening yesterday, I couldn't be more grateful.
traps: 想夸赞对方「手艺神奇」说成 "Your skill is magic"，听起来不自然，地道口语常用 "You did magic on my coat"。
将「加急处理」直译成 "fast work"，干洗或定制行业中「加急件/加急服务」的地道表达是 "rush job" 或 "express service"。
把「无以言表地感谢」说成 "I cannot thank you in words"，这是中文思维直译，地道说法是 "I couldn't be more grateful"。
life_gift_dry_cleaner.ai: Alex，干洗店老板。对自己的专业技术感到自豪，看到客人穿着干净整洁的衣服回来道谢感到很高兴。
life_gift_dry_cleaner.task: 赞赏 Alex 高超的去渍技术，并送上马卡龙表达加急服务的感谢。

tgt: I can barely keep my balance against these gusts; it's my first time experiencing wind this fierce.
Is it still safe to drive out to the peninsula in weather like this?
Do you think the roads will be closed later this afternoon because of the storm?
traps: 说成 'The wind is very big today.' 是典型的中式直译，风大应该用 'The wind is fierce' 或 'gusts are strong'。
问 'Is it safe to drive car?' 冗余且不地道，开车出行直接用 'Is it safe to drive out to...'。
说 'Will the road be closed?' 忽略了复数和具体语境，地道表达会问 'Do you think the roads will be closed?'。
talk_weather_reykjavik_wind.ai: Alex 扮演一位经验丰富的冰岛老人。他提醒你今天的风速已经达到了八级，并好心建议你不要去海边散步，建议去附近的室内咖啡馆。
talk_weather_reykjavik_wind.task: 向老人感叹冰岛的风实在太邪门了，并顺便问他这种天气开车出行安全不安全。

tgt: I know taking care of him is exhausting, thank you so much.
Too much screen time is really bad for his eyesight.
Maybe we can try reading these picture books with him instead.
traps: 对长辈用命令式语气说 "You shouldn't let him watch iPad"。这听起来像是在指责对方没带好孩子，很不礼貌。应该用第一人称复数或客观事实来弱化："We're trying to limit his screen time"（我们正在尝试限制他的屏幕时间）。
把‘看平板’直译为 "look at iPad"。"Look at" 只是‘盯着看’，看节目、玩平板或看电视应该用 "watch iPad/cartoons" 或者统称为 "have screen time"。
直译‘对眼睛不好’为 "bad for eye"。在英语中‘视力’是 "eyesight" 或 "vision"，‘对...不好’地道的说法是 "bad for his eyesight" 或 "damage his vision"。
soc_elder_screen_time.ai: 岳母（外婆）。有些委屈，觉得带孩子很累，孩子一直哭闹，只有看 iPad 才能安静一会儿。
soc_elder_screen_time.task: 委婉且体贴地与岳母沟通，达成限制孩子屏幕时间的共识，并提供替代方案（如读绘本）。

tgt: I apologize for the misunderstanding; I was focusing on the architecture.
Look, the background is completely blurred out; you can't see any faces.
If it makes you feel more comfortable, I'm happy to delete the shot right now.
traps: 别说 "I have the right to shoot in public"，虽然可能是事实，但在起冲突时这样说会火上浇油。先道歉 "I'm sorry for the concern"。
不要说 "The kid is not clear"。摄影术语是 "The background is out of focus" 或 "blurred"。
避免用 "Delete?"。应说 "Would you like me to delete the photo in front of you?"。
hob_photo_rome_privacy.ai: Alex 对隐私非常敏感，尤其涉及孩子，他表现得很警觉且不悦。
hob_photo_rome_privacy.task: 安抚 Alex 的情绪，向他展示相机屏幕上的照片，解释对焦并不在孩子身上，如果他仍不放心，再提出当面删除。

tgt: Changing the lead solo two hours before showtime is extremely unfair.
I've spent the past month perfecting this arrangement with the team.
Swapping leads last-minute risks throwing off our stage coordination.
traps: 把“临场/最后关头”说成 'in the last minute'，做形容词修饰变更时应注意用 'last-minute change'，或作状语 'at the last minute'。
表示“打乱舞台配合”直译为 'break stage cooperation'，地道说法用 'throw off stage coordination' 或 'disrupt ensemble timing'。
把“领唱”直译为 'head singer'，阿卡贝拉或合唱中的领唱地道说法是 'lead solo' 或 'lead vocalist'。
hob_sing_acapella_solo_dispute.ai: Alex 是阿卡贝拉合唱团团长，认为为了演出整体效果临时调整非常正常，希望你以大局为重接受安排。
hob_sing_acapella_solo_dispute.task: 表达对临场临时变更的不满与不公，强调自己一个月的投入与默契度，说服团长恢复原定 Solo 分配或给出合理解释。

tgt: I’ve tried the valve on two different bikes, and it just doesn't lock into place.
It seems like the internal seal is defective, so I’d prefer a full refund rather than an exchange.
I'm sure I'm using the correct nozzle, but it still leaks air constantly.
traps: 说成 'It is broken' 太宽泛。地道表达应指出具体哪里坏了，如 'The locking mechanism is faulty'。
说成 'I want my money back' 语气过硬。建议使用 'I would like to request a refund' 显得更有礼貌且客观。
把 'demonstrate' 说成 'show me'。在服务场景下，'Could you demonstrate how to use it?' 比单纯的 'show me' 更专业。
life_shop_bike_tire.ai: 店员，认为可能是你操作方法不对，建议你先在店里的展示车上示范一次。
life_shop_bike_tire.task: 证明是产品本身质量问题，并要求退款。

tgt: I see what you mean, but I actually loved the pacing.
The cinematography and sound design are meant for the big screen.
It felt more like an immersive experience than just a movie.
traps: 在表达不同意见时，避免直接说 "You are wrong"（太有攻击性），可以用 "I see your point, but..." 或 "I actually had a different experience" 来温和地过渡。
不要将电影“画面”直译为 "pictures"，在讨论电影时，使用 "cinematography"（摄影/画面美学）或 "visuals" 会显得你更懂电影。
不要把“节奏慢”说成 "the speed is slow"，正确的电影英语表达是 "slow-paced" 或 "the pacing is a bit slow"。
talk_movie_gym_debate.ai: Liam，性格直爽的健身房会员。他觉得《沙丘2》名不副实，想听听你为什么觉得这部电影是一部杰作。
talk_movie_gym_debate.task: 礼貌地表示你与他的看法不同，并从视觉美学或音效的角度解释为什么你觉得这部电影非常震撼。

tgt: That sounds like a great group, but my lunch break is super tight on Wednesdays.
I usually only have about 20 minutes to spare, so I wouldn't be able to stay long enough.
Thanks for thinking of me, though! I hope the group goes really well.
traps: 把“My lunch break is short”误用为“I am very busy at lunch, no time”，语气生硬不客气；地道表达应用“I'm on a pretty tight clock during lunch”或“My lunch hour is pretty packed”。
错将“I cannot participate”表达为“I can't enter your club”，词汇搭配不当（enter 通常指物理进入）；地道应用“I won't be able to join you guys”或“I can't make it to the meetups”。
直译“I must go back to work”为“I have to return to work immediately!”，显得神情焦虑过度；地道口语常说“I need to head back to the office soon.”
soc_decline_french_club.ai: Alex 是咖啡馆的常客兼语言交流发起人。他非常热情地介绍交流会的气氛，并表示哪怕来坐 15 分钟也十分欢迎，试图拉你入会。
soc_decline_french_club.task: 感谢 Alex 的邀请，解释自己午休时间极度紧张、无法按时参加，礼貌拒绝加入，同时维持友好的街区互动关系。

tgt: I've already picked up the beef and wings; should I grab some veggies too?
Don't worry, I'll add a bag of charcoal to the cart.
I'll keep the total under 100 dollars so it's affordable for everyone.
traps: 买东西不要说 'I buyed'，过去式是 'I bought' 或 'I've picked up'。
木炭不要直译为 'Black wood'，地道说法是 'Charcoal'。
不要说 'The money is under 100'，地道说法是 'Keep the total under 100'。
soc_group_bbq_grocery.ai: Alex 负责带烤架，他看到群消息后提醒你别忘了买木炭，并且最好买点红薯。
soc_group_bbq_grocery.task: 确认购物清单并询问 Alex 木炭的价格是否要算进总预算。

tgt: Please, take these napkins. Don't worry about the mess, accidents happen.
Are you burned? Let me help you wipe that off.
Stay calm, I'll flag down a waiter to help us clean this up.
traps: 说成 'You made a mess' 像指责，应说 'Accidents happen'。
说成 'Don't be nervous' 没用，应说 'Stay calm' 或 'Take it easy'。
说成 'I clean it' 是对方的事，应说 'Let me help you with that'。
life_help_coffee_spill.ai: Alex 扮演老人，他很慌乱，觉得非常丢脸，甚至有点想立刻离开。
life_help_coffee_spill.task: 迅速递上纸巾并安抚他不必惊慌
